criterionAssessments.Cost and adoption: Estimate licensing and configuration effort; not measured.
criterionAssessments.Evidence and grounding: Check managed connector coverage and citation behavior.
criterionAssessments.Extensibility: Stay within the platform's supported extension model.
criterionAssessments.Lifecycle governance: Use managed publishing with approved change controls.
criterionAssessments.Outcome alignment: Validate policy answers and human escalation in a pilot.

options.pattern: Managed agent platform with approved content connectors

criterionAssessments.Cost and adoption: Estimate build and operating costs; not measured.
criterionAssessments.Evidence and grounding: Own retrieval, citation, and evaluation behavior.
criterionAssessments.Extensibility: Custom orchestration within approved service limits.
criterionAssessments.Lifecycle governance: Own releases, regression checks, and monitoring.
criterionAssessments.Operating ownership: Requires a funded product engineering and service team.
criterionAssessments.Outcome alignment: Engineer and evaluate policy answers and escalation.

options.pattern: Custom application with explicit API and retrieval boundaries

criterionAssessments.Cost and adoption: Estimate both platforms and integration; not measured.
criterionAssessments.Evidence and grounding: Expose approved evidence through typed retrieval APIs.
criterionAssessments.Extensibility: Extend policy services without replacing the whole experience.
criterionAssessments.Identity and data boundary: Test authorization across both platform boundaries.
criterionAssessments.Lifecycle governance: Coordinate API and experience releases and checks.
criterionAssessments.Operating ownership: Needs clear ownership across both platform teams.
criterionAssessments.Outcome alignment: Validate the managed experience and custom policy service.

architecture.audit: Versioned evidence and access records with human-owned retention and review
architecture.knowledgeBoundary: Read-only retrieval over approved, access-trimmed content
architecture.policyBoundary: Typed policy API and approved-source manifest

proposedDesign.assessmentBasis: Prewritten discussion draft for the fictional policy assistant, not a customer-selected design. The full dossier requires authorized architecture selection first. Product fit and production controls remain unvalidated.

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Before selecting an option, test whether approved sources can provide current policy answers without losing user permissions. Compare connector coverage, content ownership, escalation capacity, operating cost and delivery dependencies using the same three-option criteria.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Customer-owned source inventory, supported integration evidence, named operating roles, cost inputs and delivery constraints. No feasibility rating, budget or completion date has been validated.
readinessPlans.title: Feasibility And Delivery Risk

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Trace employee identity through the conversational surface, policy API and source retrieval. Assess forged identity, source prompt injection, stale evidence and sensitive-response leakage. Treat retrieved text as data, preserve source authorization, and escalate ambiguity to a policy owner instead of inventing an authoritative answer.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Security-reviewed identity and permission propagation, prohibited-data tests, freshness ownership and approved retention. This is a threat analysis starting point, not a completed security assessment.
readinessPlans.title: Threat Model And Data Flow

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: After customer selection and a separate implementation authorization, validate one synthetic source-to-answer path before broadening coverage. Plan checks for permitted and denied access, missing or stale citations, unsupported answers, ambiguity and human escalation. Tie each acceptance check to its requirement and retain failures and corrections.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Customer-approved acceptance thresholds, representative cases and independent review. No employee-assistant code is generated here; the proposed solution tests have not been executed.
readinessPlans.title: Proposed Implementation And Verification

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Define requests with verified user context, a question and correlation ID; responses with answer status, source IDs and revisions, or a human-escalation reference. Source adapters must enforce access before returning content. An API caller cannot assert its own permission scope.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Authorized integration owners, source API contracts, identity mappings and access tests. Endpoint selection and executable API specifications remain pending customer architecture selection.
readinessPlans.title: Proposed Interfaces And Integrations

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Specify least-privileged identities, approved-source boundaries, evidence integrity, protected review records and customer-owned retention. For later implementation, plan a dependency inventory, license review and software-bill-of-materials evidence before release.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Selected-platform controls, customer-approved risk disposition and actual dependency provenance. This draft is not an SBOM, certification or proof of implemented production controls.
readinessPlans.title: Security Controls And Dependency Requirements

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Document separate non-production and production change decisions. Before future rollout, require the configuration revision, access and answer-quality acceptance, limited exposure, rollback triggers and a change owner. A failed control should stop rollout and restore an approved prior configuration where supported.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Selected-platform promotion and rollback capabilities, approved regions, recovery objectives and a tested recovery procedure. No pipeline, environment, deployment or rollback is executed here.
readinessPlans.title: Proposed Deployment And Rollback

readinessPlans.label: recommendation
readinessPlans.proposal: Assign content freshness, service support and policy escalation in the customer's workflow. Plan onboarding, support training and review of failures. Compare answer coverage, unresolved inquiries, review effort, rework and total cost against customer-provided baselines without logging sensitive content.
readinessPlans.requiredEvidence: Named customer owners, inquiry baseline, success thresholds, adoption plan and approved telemetry/retention. No service handover, operational monitoring or measured outcome is claimed.
readinessPlans.title: Proposed Operations, Adoption And Measurement
